title: City’s Oldest Landmarks History Walking Tour of Toronto
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Toronto's rich history on a guided walking tour that takes you to the city's most significant historical landmarks. 

Visit the oldest church, the oldest school, the oldest post office, the oldest theatre company, the oldest public market, and a historic brewery that was once the largest in the world.

See the Don Valley Brick Works, Little Trinity Church, Enoch Turner Schoolhouse, and the Alumnae Theatre, formerly Firehall No. 4. Pass by the Globe and Mail Centre, Kings Court, Toronto’s First Post Office, St. Lawrence Hall, and the Omni King Edward Hotel.

Stroll through St. Lawrence Market and David Crombie Park before ending your tour at the Distillery Historic District.

- Discover the rich history of Toronto on a guided walking tour
- Visit the city's oldest church, school, and post office
- Explore the Distillery District and learn about its past
- See the oldest public market and a historic brewery
- Learn about the history of the biggest city in Canada
